In my 3rd year of my BSc Psychology I was introduced to the `affairs` dataset by [Mark Andrews](https://www.mjandrews.org/). The teaching course went through how to implement a logistic regression over the data and what inferences could be made. For this case study I will also implement the Bayesian approach and cover the similarities and differences as to how to approach the dataset.
